text: The Korean National Drought Information and Analysis Center (NDIAC) was established to enhance South Korea's national drought early warning and risk management capabilities. It operates as a national platform under the Korea Water Resources Corporation (K-water) and collaborates with the National Drought Mitigation Center (NDMC) from the University of Nebraska–Lincoln. The center aims to institutionalize drought risk governance by leveraging international expertise and domestic capacities, focusing on meteorological, hydrological, and agricultural drought risks.
